page.title: WeCom Mail
page.description: Delivers sign-up verification codes, password security notices and site notifications through the WeCom “app send email” API — no SMTP server or sending domain required.
page.noSecrets: The platform encryption key is not configured, so WeCom credentials cannot be saved.
field.corpIdHint: WeCom admin console → My Enterprise → Enterprise info.
field.corpSecretHint: Leave empty to keep the saved secret. Only re-enter it when switching enterprise or after regenerating it.
field.fromHint: WeCom decides the actual From address from the app's bound mailbox; this is for operator reference only.
field.baseUrlHint: Defaults to https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com; point it at an internal proxy or mirror if needed.
field.publicBaseUrlHint: Used to turn in-site notification links into absolute URLs, e.g. https://panel.example.com.
field.excludeTypesHint: Comma-separated type prefixes. For example security. keeps all security notices in-app only.
test.title: Send a test email
test.hint: The test really calls WeCom, so it verifies the credentials, the mailbox permission and the trusted-IP allowlist at once.
help.title: Three prerequisites before enabling this
help.steps: ① Create a self-built app in the WeCom console and copy its corpid and secret; ② the app must have the enterprise-mailbox (mail) permission; ③ if the enterprise enables trusted IPs, add this server's egress IP, otherwise the API answers 60020.
connect.title: One-click connect
connect.pasteHint: Paste the enterprise ID and this self-built app's Secret together — two lines, a JSON blob or a link with query parameters all work. Connecting verifies them against the real API immediately and sends a test email to the address below.
connect.testToggle: Send a test email to {{email}} after connecting
connect.testToggleNoEmail: Send a test email to the address above after connecting
connect.successWithTest: Connected — test email accepted by WeCom
connect.testFailed: Credentials work, but the test email did not go out ({{email}}): {{reason}}
connect.testFailedUnknown: check the WeCom error code in the service logs
advanced.title: Advanced settings (internal proxy, exclusions, sender display)
warning.duplicateChannel: {{channels}} is configured and sending too: the kernel fans one notification out to every channel, so users would get duplicate emails. Keep a single delivery channel, or exclude the affected notification types in one of them.
error.connectFailed: Connect failed — check what you pasted, or try again later
remedy.wecom-mail.missing_corp_id: No enterprise ID found. It looks like `ww` followed by 16 characters, at the bottom of My Enterprise → Enterprise info.
remedy.wecom-mail.missing_secret: No app secret found. Open Apps → your self-built app and click “View secret”; an admin has to scan a QR code first.
remedy.wecom-mail.no_secrets: The platform has no encryption key configured, so credentials cannot be stored. Set the key on the server and try again.
remedy.wecom.invalid_corp_id: The enterprise ID is wrong. Copy it again from My Enterprise → Enterprise info.
remedy.wecom.invalid_secret: The app secret is wrong or was reset. Regenerate it in the console and copy the new value.
remedy.wecom.ip_not_allowed: This app enforces trusted IPs: add this server's egress IP under Apps → your app → Trusted IPs, or turn the restriction off.
remedy.wecom.mail_forbidden: This app has no enterprise-mailbox (mail) API permission. Enable the mailbox/mail permission for your self-built app in the WeCom console and retry; errcode 48002 means exactly that.
remedy.wecom.rate_limited: WeCom rate-limited the call. Wait a minute and try again.
remedy.wecom.token_invalid: WeCom rejected the access token (it was probably just reset). We refreshed it once and still failed — check whether the secret was regenerated moments ago.
remedy.wecom.network_error: Cannot reach the WeCom API. Check egress, DNS or proxy settings.
remedy.wecom.bad_response: WeCom returned something unexpected (possibly a proxy error page). Check `baseUrl` and the network path.
remedy.wecom.send_failed: WeCom rejected this send. Make sure the sender mailbox is enabled on the WeCom side and check the raw error code in the service logs.
connect.corpIdLink: Cannot find the enterprise ID? Open My Enterprise in the WeCom console (the ID sits at the bottom).
